html_title: 1Overview of SWAM. We study how multisource supervision preserves the language–video capabilities acquired during video pretraining and extends them to robot control. We curate a multisource data pool of approximately 47,000 hours to support this study. Experiments show that additional pretraining further improves real-world performance, and that the resulting recipe generalizes to unseen scene conditions in RoboTwin and on real robots.
